title: Infrastructure Overview
description: All Windows and Linux servers: health, CPU, memory, disk

panels.title: Average CPU
panels.query: avg(clamp(max by (host) (last_over_time(observaone_cpu_utilization_ratio[1m])) * 100, 0, 100) or clamp(max by (host) (100 - avg by (instance, host) (rate(windows_cpu_time_total{mode="idle"}[5m])) * 100), 0, 100) or clamp(max by (host) (100 - avg by (instance, host) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle",agent!="observaone"}[5m])) * 100), 0, 100))

panels.title: Average memory
panels.query: avg(max by (host) (100 * (1 - windows_memory_available_bytes / windows_memory_physical_total_bytes)) or max by (host) (100 * (1 - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes)))

panels.title: CPU used by server
panels.query: clamp(max by (host) (last_over_time(observaone_cpu_utilization_ratio[1m])) * 100, 0, 100) or clamp(max by (host) (100 - avg by (instance, host) (rate(windows_cpu_time_total{mode="idle"}[5m])) * 100), 0, 100) or clamp(max by (host) (100 - avg by (instance, host) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle",agent!="observaone"}[5m])) * 100), 0, 100)

panels.title: Memory used by server
panels.query: max by (host) (100 * (1 - windows_memory_available_bytes / windows_memory_physical_total_bytes)) or max by (host) (100 * (1 - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes))
